source.title: How to Make Your House a Home: Family Liturgy and Religious Practices
source.institution: Family Life Bureau, National Catholic Welfare Conference
source.author_dependency_warning: This is a 1955 compiler's presentation with frequent attributed excerpts from Maria von Trapp, Therese Mueller, Donald Attwater, Katherine Byles, and others. A new author/source is NOT evidence of independent witnessing for each act.

methodology: One separately described act or variant per observation, anchored to EWTN transcription lines. Repeat line locators are intentional when one paragraph contains multiple separable actions. The result is NOT complete line-by-line coverage, does not certify the original printed edition, and does not treat suggestions as historical custom attestation. All source terms reworded briefly; no long quotation, prayer, recipe or hymn reproduction.
